title: Kneeling Warrior with Hammer
description: A woman with short black hair and blue outfit kneels on a stone path, gripping a large ornate hammer with a glowing blue hilt. Behind her looms a massive dark castle shaped like a monstrous creature with glowing white eyes and sharp teeth, set against a dramatic sky with swirling orange clouds, a yellow sun and a green moon.
prompt: A woman with short black hair wearing a blue crop top and shorts kneels on cracked stone ground, holding a massive glowing blue hammer. Behind her stands a gigantic gothic castle shaped like a demonic monster with glowing eyes and sharp teeth. Dramatic swirling orange clouds, a bright yellow sun and a luminous green moon fill the sky. White line-art flowers frame the foreground, fantasy style, cinematic lighting.
